description:
Both plots share a common x-axis labeled “Steps” with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 500, with tick labels at regular intervals of 100. They also share a common y-axis labeled “Training Rewards” with a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.4 for the top plot and 0.0 to 0.2 for the bottom plot, with tick labels at regular intervals of 0.1.

The first plot, labeled “Easy Training Set”, displays two lines. A blue line, representing “Llama-On-Policy-Easy”, begins at approximately 0.05 and increases to approximately 0.32, exhibiting fluctuations throughout. A red line, representing "Llama-LUFFY-Easy", starts at approximately 0.03 and rises to approximately 0.35, with a similar pattern of fluctuations. 

The second plot, labeled “Hard Training Set”, also presents two lines. A blue line, representing “Llama-On-Policy-Hard”, begins at approximately 0.01 and rises to approximately 0.15, showing moderate fluctuations. A red line, representing “Llama-LUFFY-Hard”, starts at approximately 0.01 and increases to approximately 0.2, displaying more pronounced fluctuations throughout the range of the x-axis.
